banner.eyebrow: HOME-OPS • AI • CHAT ON THE B70
banner.title: vllm
banner.tagline: Serves the household chat model from the single Arc B70 as llama.cpp, with a bounded prompt cache and alerts for host memory.

explainer.title: One card, one chat model, a bounded cache

steps.title: Model
steps.text: The pod downloads a Q3_K_M GGUF of the chat model on first start into a 50 Gi claim. A 30-minute startup probe covers that download.
steps.scene: a model file arriving on a card's memory

steps.title: Card
steps.text: The pod takes the single Arc Pro B70 through devic.es/b70 and runs llama.cpp on SYCL. vLLM cannot finish warming up this model on one card (intel/llm-scaler#382).
steps.scene: a single GPU board with one slot taken

steps.title: Cache
steps.text: A prompt cache capped at 4096 MiB, with a glibc tunable and the oneDNN attention pin, keeps host memory from growing without a bound.
steps.scene: a cache vessel with a fixed fill line

steps.title: Priority
steps.text: The chat-gpu-high class outranks CI runners and tdarr, so the 8-CPU request is always schedulable on talos-3.
steps.scene: a priority ladder with one rung above the rest

steps.title: Alias
steps.text: The server is named ${CHAT_MODEL_ID}. LiteLLM reaches it at vllm-app on port 8000 as chat-local, so consumers never see the real model name.
steps.scene: a routing switch pointing at one port

art.about: a local chat model server on one GPU, with a bounded prompt cache, host memory alerts and a LiteLLM alias in front
art.title: How the chat model runs on one card
